dedupe_keys.name: awesome datasets about datacenter curated index

description: This GitHub index lists public data sources for data-center and cloud studies. Its README points to Google cluster traces, the IMC 2010 data-center measurements, the Cloud Measurement Project and a netflow repository; two more items are labelled future releases without links. The repository includes short per-source notes and an MIT licence for the index. Its discovery value is as a small route to compute-workload and network-performance traces, not as a combined dataset with a common schema. Coverage is four linked entries in the checked README, with uncertain update frequency and mixed publisher rights. During this review the Google collection matched existing data-google-cluster-workload-traces, the IMC 2010 page returned HTTP 404, the Cloud Measurement page was reachable, and the netflow repository lacked a README. The index therefore requires link-level checks before each reuse. Simulation use includes finding workload or latency inputs, but no measurement from the linked sources should be treated as licensed under the index’s MIT grant. No linked archive was downloaded.
licence: MIT for directory repository; linked datasets retain their own terms.
